title: KAD-PI Native OMP Control Plane, Live Token/Quota Telemetry, Developer Toolchain, Security Gates, and Native Operator UI
acceptance_criteria: Approved tool census and missing tooling installation complete with zero duplicate plugins.
Provider-neutral telemetry schema normalizes token and non-token metrics with explicit epistemic provenance.
No fake token conversions for non-token quotas; unknown limits remain UNKNOWN.
Deterministic reconciliation and staleness semantics are preserved with local ledger persistence.
All configured OMP providers appear in the detailed inventory with truthful capability/quota state.
Existing economic router, workctl claim/frontier, and service health states are truthfully projected.
AMD GPU telemetry (utilization, VRAM, temp, power) is captured via structured amdgpu_top output.
Native OMP extension implements compact meter, detailed panel, commands, keybinding, and theme integration.
Context7 MCP is configured project-scoped without credentials.
Deterministic security gates (gitleaks, trivy, shellcheck, shfmt, actionlint, lychee, prek) are integrated.
All 47 research regression tests and full test suite remain green.
Comprehensive evidence package and operator documentation are produced.
description: Deterministic operator control plane for KAD-PI providing live token/quota telemetry, economic/workctl projection, developer toolchain security gates, and native OMP TUI components.
